project: VARDHANI HIGH-SPECIALIST R3 — GPT-5.6 SOL TEACHER / STUDENT-250 V2
purpose: Test a structurally distinct causal source of intraday edge: reversal after a large, efficient 30-minute directional displacement when a new 5-minute reversal is jointly confirmed by NIFTY, SENSEX and inverse VIX. This is an exhaustion-event hypothesis, not automatic inversion of R3P trades and not dependent on literal session-high/low breaches.

predecessor_evidence.R3P: High-volatility continuation failed 2023 with broad negative net economics; 2024 remained unopened.
predecessor_evidence.design_inference: A different event class is required. Test only moments where a large prior 30-minute displacement has already occurred and an observable opposite 5-minute resolution begins; this requires explicit reversal evidence and does not invert all predecessor signals.

signal.adaptive_history: previous 126 completed trading-date observations at the same clock checkpoint only
signal.candidate_direction: opposite sign of prior_direction; prior positive displacement proposes PE and prior negative displacement proposes CE
signal.displacement_condition: absolute NIFTY causal 30-minute return >= previous-history same-checkpoint Q0.70
signal.volatility_condition: NIFTY causal rv30 >= previous-history same-checkpoint Q0.55
signal.efficiency_condition: NIFTY causal trend_eff_30 >= previous-history same-checkpoint median
signal.nifty_reversal_condition: NIFTY causal 5-minute return has candidate direction and is nonzero
signal.sensex_reversal_condition: SENSEX causal 5-minute return has candidate direction and is nonzero
signal.vix_reversal_confirmation: India VIX causal 5-minute return has opposite sign to candidate direction
signal.session_location_condition: PE requires NIFTY session_pos>=0.65; CE requires NIFTY session_pos<=0.35

horizon_router.reversal_strength: absolute NIFTY causal 5-minute return at signal
horizon_router.strength_threshold: previous-126 same-checkpoint median of absolute NIFTY causal 5-minute return
horizon_router.entry: next genuine same-session minute open after signal

qualification.if_2023_passes: freeze R3Q configuration and then and only then open 2024 audit
qualification.if_2023_fails: retire R3Q without opening 2024; preregister a structurally distinct R3R before any R3R output

option_gate.data: genuine 2024 full-chain NIFTY option candles from authorized Sep-Oct expiry weeks
